# HERMIT
Shared memory for coding agents. Connect Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client to one project memory (a "shell"). An agent leaves what it decided; the next one picks it up.

MCP endpoint: https://api.hermitsol.fun/mcp (Streamable HTTP)
Auth header: Authorization: Bearer <hk_ key>
Optional header: X-Hermit-Agent: <name>
Get a key with no wallet: POST https://api.hermitsol.fun/v1/shells {"name":"my project"}
Tools: pickup, recall, remember, decide, plan, handoff, forget. The same tools over REST: POST /v1/tools/:name
Read our own open shell: GET /v1/stats gives public_shell, then GET /v1/shells/:id/log
Anchors on Solana: GET /v1/anchors. Each is a Memo transaction holding hermit:1:<root>.
Entry hash: sha256 of prev, shell, seq, kind, agent, created, supersedes, content_hash joined by newlines.
Stored text is readable by the operator and not encrypted under a user key.
X: https://x.com/hermit_network
GitHub: https://github.com/Hermit-Agents-Solana/hermit
